+    selected: list[str] = []
+    for index, job in enumerate(jobs):

+            f"scenarios/{group}/{library}"

+        ]
+        selected.extend(
+            path for path in paths if any(path.startswith(r + "/") for r in roots)
+        )
+        assert job["cache_dependency_glob"].splitlines() == [
+            f"{root}/**/uv.lock" for root in roots
+        ]
+        assert job["report_paths"].splitlines() == [

+    assert Counter(selected) == Counter(paths)

@copilot Update this PR directly with the small test simplifications below, without changing automatic sharding behavior or expanding the PR scope.

In tools/runner/tests/test_scenario_matrix.py, replace the generic subprocess_call helper, which accepts an arbitrary callable and requires Any, Callable, and TypeVar, with a small typed helper around subprocess.run returning subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]. Replace subprocess.check_output uses with the new helper and .stdout. Preserve each launch's input, capture, check, cwd, and environment behavior. Keep centralized CREATE_NO_WINDOW handling on Windows and zero flags elsewhere, and retain regression coverage for both platforms.

Shorten the helper's mocked regression test so it verifies platform flag selection, argument forwarding, and the returned result without repeating the current long list of sample keyword arguments. Remove test_new_libraries_are_automatically_included, whose coverage overlaps the round-robin, configurable-count, and tracked-scenarios standalone-CLI tests. Retain those tests and the workflow integration test, including failure continuation, assigned-root patch isolation, and combining nonoverlapping patches.

Leave the production matrix builder and workflow unchanged. Run the focused scenario-matrix tests and applicable lint/type checks. Do not create another PR.
